title: Safe Harbor is adopted by an onchain contract call, with the definitive legal text pinned on IPFS
content:
A.2.11.1.2.1 states that "[s]afe Harbor is an onchain agreement," and that "[t]he agreement located at the IPFS address shown in the smart contract above is the definitive version." A.2.11.1.2.2 directs execution: the Core Facilitator includes "the adoption of Safe Harbor in an upcoming Executive Spell" by "calling the `adoptSafeHarbor` function on the Safe Harbor registry contract."

The design achievement is giving a DAO a way to enter a binding public undertaking. Sky has no signatory, no letterhead, and no corporate seal; what it does have is a governance-controlled address whose transactions unambiguously express collective intent. Adoption by Executive Spell means the agreement was authorized by the same process as every other protocol change, with the same auditability.

The terms themselves are encoded as call parameters rather than prose — `bountyCapUSD`, `bountyPercentage`, `diligenceRequirements`, `identity`, `retainable`, and a per-chain `chains` structure carrying chain IDs, recovery addresses, and contract scope (A.2.11.1.2.2.3.1 through .3.3.3). A prospective rescuer can read Sky's exact commitments from chain state before acting, which is the property that makes acting-first rational.

A.2.11.1.2.6 closes the loop by declaring that the Atlas section itself "constitutes the 'Agreement Fact Page' as specified in the Safe Harbor Agreement" — the external agreement's required disclosures are satisfied by the Atlas, so the two documents reference each other rather than duplicating terms.

The maintenance coupling is explicit: A.2.11.1.2.3 requires that "[w]henever a contract is added to the Bug Bounty Program, it should also be added to Safe Harbor," with Spell Teams responsible and the Core Facilitator reviewing — preventing the two registries from drifting apart.
description: A Spell calls adoptSafeHarbor on the registry with parameters encoding the terms; the agreement referenced from the contract is authoritative, so the legal instrument is executed like a transaction.
